svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: PostgreSQL StatefulSet with CSI storage and backups subtitle: A headless Service gives each replica a stable name, each pod claims its own volume from the Longhorn CSI driver, and Velero backs it all up # One column per ordinal, top to bottom: pod, claim, volume. The edge labels then add height, # not width, so the figure stays legible in an 880px README column (orrery review). direction: down layout: { spacing: compact } legend: solid: Traffic and references dashed: Creates dotted: Backups groups: cluster: { type: k8s:cluster, label: Kubernetes cluster } ns: { type: k8s:namespace, label: Namespace orders, in: cluster } # The StatefulSet owns its pods; the claims it stamps out from volumeClaimTemplates outlive them, so they sit outside. sts: { type: box, label: StatefulSet postgres, icon: k8s:sts, in: ns } velero-ns: { type: k8s:namespace, label: Namespace velero, in: cluster } # PersistentVolumes, the StorageClass and the CSI driver are cluster wide, so they sit outside the # namespace. A short header keeps it clear of the line into the first volume. pvs: { type: box, label: PVs, icon: k8s:pv, in: cluster } nodes: # Laid out above the cluster (see its edge), so the backup leg is one short line. bucket: { icon: generic:bucket, label: Object storage, note: S3-compatible bucket } # Beside the Service (align), so the client's call is one short line across the top. api: { icon: k8s:pod, label: orders-api, note: Client pods, in: ns, align: svc } svc: { icon: k8s:svc, label: Headless Service, note: "postgres, clusterIP None", in: ns } pod0: { icon: k8s:pod, label: postgres-0, note: Primary, in: sts } pod1: { icon: k8s:pod, label: postgres-1, note: Replica, in: sts } pod2: { icon: k8s:pod, label: postgres-2, note: Replica, in: sts } pvc0: { icon: k8s:pvc, label: data-postgres-0, in: ns } pvc1: { icon: k8s:pvc, label: data-postgres-1, in: ns } pvc2: { icon: k8s:pvc, label: data-postgres-2, in: ns } # No Velero mark in the packs: a generic backup glyph. velero: { icon: tabler:history, label: Velero, note: CSI snapshots, in: velero-ns } pv0: { icon: k8s:pv, label: PersistentVolume, note: 50Gi RWO, in: pvs } pv1: { icon: k8s:pv, label: PersistentVolume, note: 50Gi RWO, in: pvs } pv2: { icon: k8s:pv, label: PersistentVolume, note: 50Gi RWO, in: pvs } # The driver and the class share the volumes' row (rank, align), right of them. csi: { icon: si:longhorn, label: Longhorn CSI driver, note: driver.longhorn.io, in: cluster, align: sc } sc: { icon: k8s:sc, label: StorageClass, note: longhorn, in: cluster, rank: last } edges: - api -> svc: postgres-0.postgres # The headless Service is the StatefulSet's serviceName: one DNS record per pod. - svc -> sts: per-pod DNS # One column per ordinal: each pod mounts its own claim, bound to its own volume. - pod0 -> pvc0: mounts - pod1 -> pvc1: mounts - pod2 -> pvc2: mounts - pvc0 -> pv0: bound - pvc1 -> pv1: bound - pvc2 -> pv2: bound # The claim template names the class and the class names the driver, which creates the volumes. # Only class -> driver is laid out, so the two stay on the volumes' row. - sts -> sc: { label: storageClassName, constraint: false } - sc -> csi: provisioner - csi --> pvs: { constraint: false } # Drawn after layout, so the Velero namespace sits beside the orders namespace. - { from: velero, to: ns, line: dotted, label: nightly backup, constraint: false } # Laid out bucket -> Velero so the bucket sits above the cluster; the arrowhead stays on the bucket. - { from: bucket, to: velero, arrow: start, line: dotted, label: S3 API }

svg.title: PostgreSQL StatefulSet with CSI storage and backups
svg.desc: PostgreSQL StatefulSet with CSI storage and backups. 15 components in 5 groups. Connections: orders-api to Headless Service (postgres-0.postgres); Headless Service to StatefulSet postgres (per-pod DNS); postgres-0 to data-postgres-0 (mounts); postgres-1 to data-postgres-1 (mounts); postgres-2 to data-postgres-2 (mounts); data-postgres-0 to PersistentVolume (bound); data-postgres-1 to PersistentVolume (bound); data-postgres-2 to PersistentVolume (bound); StatefulSet postgres to StorageClass (storageClassName); StorageClass to Longhorn CSI driver (provisioner); Longhorn CSI driver to PVs; Velero to Namespace orders (nightly backup); Object storage to Velero (S3 API).

text.tspan: POSTGRESQL STATEFULSET WITH CSI STORAGE AND BACKUPS
A headless Service gives each replica a stable name, each pod claims its own volume from the Longhorn CSI driver, and Velero backs it all up
